items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: But he had learned me, the fingering, from the bugle and everything.

ctx.x: You learned that when you were just a boy too, very often. That's right. And I was, when I was around seven years old, that's when I got on this bugle. It was like that. And he kept me on this bugle about a year. Well, it was longer than that. Because we went to the end of the, because at that time the KP used to go away every two years, what they called an encampment. It used to take the boys to band with them. Yes. And we went to In and Out with Indiana in 1911. In 1911. And that was just before we went there…
